description.narrative: In a protracted multiple crisis context, Al Majmoua is striving to continue supporting its staff, its micro-credit clients and non-financial services’ beneficiaries. This project aims at securing Al Majmoua’s businesses continuity by means of digitization and a direct financial support to the staff of the institution. This emergency grant will allow Al Majmoua to conduct its daily business by i) renewing the subscription cost of key licences (without which a number of operating systems could not be sustained) and purchasing essential IT assets to allow for remote work of key staff and by ii) providing a financial cash assistance to the staff of the institution who have seen the value of their salary reduced by 80% and are no longer able to cover some of their basic needs.
